newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL rubber quoted up at noon, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: KL rubber quoted up at noon, trade quiet.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted higher at noon but trade remained quiet due to the depression in regional markets, traders said.
"There's no leads to prompt any shortcovering or buying at the moment," said one trader.
The soft ringgit against the U.S. dollar has made sellers queasy about quoting lower prices for Malaysian rubber, which was traded in the ringgit, said traders.
At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB) quoted the benchmark RSS1 buyer for August at 239 cents (91 U.S. cents) a kg, up one cent from Monday's close.
